summary: A Google DeepMind researcher announces Gemini 3.8 Flash as an upgrade over 3.7 Flash, claiming it outperforms most larger frontier models on complex engineering problems at lower cost.

practices.reason: The post claims the new Flash model beats larger frontier models on engineering tasks for less cost, but gives no specific benchmark figures, so it should be checked before relying on it.
practices.quote: 3.8 Flash is a big step up from 3.7 Flash, outperforming most larger frontier models in complex engineering problems, at a fraction of the cost.
